description: Labeled offline retrieval-eval fixture for fabri. `corpus` is a set of guidelines of the shape fabri mines from run traces; `queries` are tasks with the guideline label(s) that SHOULD surface for them (binary relevance). Guideline `id` labels are fixture-local: the store derives the real point id from a hash of the text, so the runner maps label -> real id after upsert. Texts must be unique within a kind (identical text in one kind collapses under the id hash). v1 scope: dense/hybrid/domain coverage; tool-tag slots are out of scope (retrieve is called without tool_names). Regenerate baselines with `python -m fabri.benchmarks.retrieval_eval`.

corpus.label: read-file-missing
corpus.text: When read_file targets a path that may not exist, check existence first; a missing path aborts the step and wastes a turn.

corpus.label: edit-file-exact
corpus.text: edit_file requires the old string to match the file exactly including whitespace; copy the target text verbatim rather than retyping it from memory.

corpus.label: write-file-newline
corpus.text: write_file does not append a trailing newline; include one explicitly when the consumer expects a POSIX line ending at end of file.

corpus.label: bash-cwd
corpus.text: bash commands run from the sandbox root, not from a file's directory; use absolute paths or cd within a single command.

corpus.label: python-venv
corpus.text: Invoke Python through the project's .venv interpreter, not the system python, or imports of the local package fail with ModuleNotFoundError.

corpus.label: grep-before-edit
corpus.text: Grep for a symbol across the repo before editing it so every call site is updated together and nothing is left dangling.

corpus.label: diff-review
corpus.text: Review the git diff before committing; an unintended edit to a neighbouring line is easy to make and hard to notice later.

corpus.label: web-search-focused
corpus.text: web_search works best with a short focused query of three to six keywords, not the entire task sentence pasted verbatim.

corpus.label: fetch-timeout
corpus.text: web_fetch on a slow host can hang the whole run; set a timeout and fall back to a cached summary on failure.

corpus.label: search-then-fetch
corpus.text: Use web_search to find candidate URLs, then web_fetch only the top result; fetching every hit burns tokens for little gain.

corpus.label: stale-results
corpus.text: Search results can be months stale; prefer a source with a visible recent date when the question is time-sensitive.

corpus.label: api-auth-header
corpus.text: Most API endpoints require an Authorization header; read the bearer token from the environment and never hardcode it in the request.

corpus.label: api-rate-limit
corpus.text: On HTTP 429 back off exponentially and retry; hammering the endpoint gets the key rate-limited or banned.

corpus.label: api-pagination
corpus.text: List endpoints paginate; follow the next cursor until it is null or you silently miss records past the first page.

corpus.label: api-json-guard
corpus.text: Confirm a response is JSON before parsing it; an HTML error page raises an opaque decode error that hides the real HTTP status.

corpus.label: api-idempotency
corpus.text: Send an idempotency key on POST retries so a network retry does not create the same resource twice.

corpus.label: plan-decompose
corpus.text: For a multi-part task, decompose it into sub-questions first; a single monolithic prompt loses track of the later parts.

corpus.label: plan-verify-gate
corpus.text: End every code change by running the project's real build and test gate before claiming the work is done.

corpus.label: plan-smallest-cut
corpus.text: Ship the smallest vertical slice that delivers one real outcome and defer everything else to a later pass.

corpus.label: plan-write-down
corpus.text: Write the plan down before executing a long task so progress survives a context reset and steps are not silently dropped.

corpus.label: retry-loop-stop
corpus.text: If the same tool fails with the same error twice, stop retrying and change approach; a third identical call fails the same way.

corpus.label: context-frugal
corpus.text: Keep the injected context small; dumping raw history into the prompt inflates every turn's input token cost with no benefit.

corpus.label: tool-name-exact
corpus.text: Call tools by their exact registered name; a mistyped tool name is silently ignored and the step produces nothing.

corpus.label: ask-when-blocked
corpus.text: When a required fact is genuinely unknowable from the task, ask the user once with a precise question instead of guessing.

corpus.label: no-secrets-in-logs
corpus.text: Never echo API keys or tokens into the trace or logs; redact them so a shared trace cannot leak a credential.

corpus.label: prefer-batch-tools
corpus.text: Batch independent tool calls in one step so they run in parallel instead of paying a full round-trip for each in sequence.

corpus.label: json-schema-strict
corpus.text: When a response schema is set, match it exactly; an extra or missing field triggers a re-prompt and costs an extra turn.

corpus.label: path-traversal-guard
corpus.text: Reject file paths containing .. before opening them so a crafted path cannot escape the sandbox root.

corpus.label: large-file-chunk
corpus.text: Read a large file in ranges rather than all at once so a single read does not blow the context window.

corpus.label: empty-search-broaden
corpus.text: If a search returns nothing, broaden the query by dropping the most specific term rather than repeating the same words.

corpus.label: cite-source
corpus.text: Cite the source URL for any external fact so a later reviewer can verify the claim instead of trusting it blind.

corpus.label: api-timeout-retry
corpus.text: Wrap an API call in a bounded timeout and retry transient 5xx errors a few times before giving up on the request.

corpus.label: api-field-select
corpus.text: Request only the fields you need from an API that supports field selection so the response stays small and cheap to parse.

corpus.label: plan-order-deps
corpus.text: Order sub-tasks by dependency so a step never runs before the output it needs exists; a dependency-blind order stalls.

corpus.label: plan-parallel-independent
corpus.text: Fan independent sub-tasks out to run at once and only serialise the ones that truly depend on each other's results.

corpus.label: generic-fail-fast
corpus.text: Surface a failure loudly with the real error text instead of swallowing it; a silent failure is discovered far too late.

corpus.label: generic-confirm-destructive
corpus.text: Confirm before a destructive or hard-to-reverse action; approval for one delete does not extend to the next one.

corpus.label: code-run-tests-first
corpus.text: Run the failing test before changing code so you can tell a real fix from a coincidence when it later goes green.

corpus.label: search-domain-scope
corpus.text: Scope a search to a specific site or domain when you know where the answer lives instead of searching the whole web.

corpus.label: api-error-body
corpus.text: Read the response body on a failed API call, not just the status code; the body usually names the exact field that was wrong.
